findings.what: No `test` script; `npm test` fails with 'Missing script: "test"'. Suite only runs via `node --test` and its HTTP tests require a prior `npm run build` that nothing wires up.
Tentang Kami page is not linked from anywhere (no nav, Beranda only links /kontak); visitors cannot discover the profile page.
saveContactMessage errors are not caught; a DB failure produces an unhandled server-action error with no user-facing message and lost form input.
Starter metadata 'Create Next App' left in place and html lang='en' for Indonesian content (a11y/SEO).
SQLite file at relative path data/contact-messages.db is undocumented and breaks on read-only/serverless hosts.
